input.overview: On io-shop, the stored monthly spend totals for shoppers who made purchases after a feature setting was switched on fell short of what those shoppers had actually bought. The likely cause is that once the setting was on, the shop recorded each purchase but did not add it to the shopper's stored running total for the month. The problem lasted {duration}. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in lost takings at {customer_loss}. No one was paged, because no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus did not act on the suspected cause itself. Nothing could show whether the step that would test it worked within the time Argus waits, so Argus recommends reverting the monthly-spend-feature setting rather than doing it. Argus has also proposed a fix, which is open as a draft and has not been applied.
